name: P90
description:
The P90, or Project 90, was an attempt to fulfill a desire for a standardized PDW. Though this never happened, the P90 has enjoyed constant media attention in part because of its unique design and its 5.7mm cartridge. With good damage, decently low recoil, and a very high RPM, the P90 is a solid choice for every situation.
It's O'Neill, with TWO L's!
